intro.title: Compliance & Integrity
intro.text: Five Investment Limited operates in accordance with the laws of South Sudan and maintains all required registrations, licences, and certifications. We uphold transparency in every engagement.

items.question: Is Five Investment Limited legally registered?
items.answer: Yes, we are fully incorporated under the laws of South Sudan and hold all required business licences and tax registrations.

items.question: Can you work with NGOs and UN agencies?
items.answer: Absolutely. We are registered on the UN Global Marketplace (UNGM) and have extensive experience serving humanitarian and development organisations.

items.question: Can you provide copies of your registration documents?
items.answer: Certainly. Contact us or visit the Download Centre on this page to obtain verified copies.

items.question: Are your tax documents up to date?
items.answer: Yes, we maintain current tax compliance certificates and file all required returns.

items.question: Do you sign formal contracts?
items.answer: Yes, every engagement is governed by a legally binding contract or MOU that protects both parties.

contactVerification.title: Need Additional Documents?
contactVerification.text: If you require copies of our legal documents or compliance certificates, please contact our team. We are happy to provide the necessary documentation to support your procurement or due diligence process.
